origin: Own linearized nonreciprocal metamaterial amplitude chain, using an asymmetric nearest-neighbor model to study boundary sensitivity. The amplitudes are real dimensionless resolved coordinates with Euclidean forcing/response norms. This is a deliberately active/nonreciprocal linear model; no equilibrium reciprocity, conservative Hamiltonian, measured device or quantum probability conservation is asserted. All coefficients below are exact constructed specifications.
model: ForN in[4,8,12], dot u=A_N(eta)u+f. The N-by-N real matrix has diagonal-4.2, lower nearest-neighbor entriesA[j+1,j]=4, and upper entriesA[j,j+1]=1 forj0..N-2. In additionA[0,N-1]=4eta andA[N-1,0]=eta, all other entries0. Eta is a dimensionless boundary-closure fraction in[0,1]. Rates4.2,4,1have inverse-time units; uand each forcing-component use the same fixed physical coordinates across boundary choices. Eta0 is open, eta1 periodic. No Euclidean norm may be silently changed during a nonorthogonal similarity transform.
spectral_boundary_questions: Construct every complete open and periodic matrix in the same site order. Derive an exact diagonal similarity from the open matrix to a real symmetric nearest-neighbor matrix, and verify it through actual registered matrix products and complete symmetric spectral outputs. Obtain the complete finite periodic spectrum through its discrete Fourier modes and independently verify the full characteristic polynomial root inventory with registered PolynomialRoots; retain all complex roots, not only the most unstable one. Also retain registered complete roots of the open characteristic polynomial to cross-check the symmetric-spectrum route. Report open spectra in decreasing eigenvalue order. Periodic real/imaginary pairs must be in Bloch orderk=2pi*m/N,m0..N-1, with Fourier conventionu_j=exp(ikj). Derive the infinite periodic Bloch curve and its signed point-gap winding about0 as k increases0to2pi; determine whether0lies on that curve. A winding belongs to a continuous Bloch curve, not an inference from three finite sampled polygons. Assess open versus periodic Hurwitz stability and the side where open right eigenvectors accumulate. Retain similarity diagonal condition numbers; mathematical spectral equivalence alone need not preserve physical response gains.
forced_response_and_robustness: For every open chain obtain the complete actual registered inverseG_N=(-A_N(0))^(-1), and feed this actual full matrix to registered MatrixSVD. Define H_N(omega)=(i*omega*I-A_N(0))^(-1) and its Euclidean induced2norm. Find the GLOBAL maximum over all real frequencies, not an arbitrary frequency grid, and report each peak gain and its attaining frequency. Prove the global frequency claim from the physical positive semigroup or another rigorous bound. Define the unstructured complex additive stability radiusr_N as the infimum ||Delta||_2over arbitrary complex constant N-by-Nmatrices Delta for whichA_N(0)+Delta is not Hurwitz. Derive its relation to the global resolvent gain, including attainability, rather than confusing it with distance from the rightmost eigenvalue to0. Determine whether a minimizing destabilizing Delta can in this model be chosen real, entrywise nonnegative and rank1. Singular-vector signs are arbitrary; paired sign choices cannot change an outer-product perturbation or a physical conclusion.
structured_boundary_threshold: For every N find the FIRSTeta_cin(0,1)whereA_N(eta)ceases to be Hurwitz as eta increases from0. Prove there is no earlier oscillatory crossing or hidden branch, using the irreducible Metzler/Perron structure or an equivalent global argument. Derive the complete determinant-at-zero polynomial in eta from the actual finite chain, retain all registered polynomial roots including the nonphysical root, and select the first admissible positive threshold. AtN8retain a complete actual linear-system solution establishing the positive zero mode, normalize it to sum1, and verify the full critical generator residual. This first loss of stability must not automatically be called an exceptional point. Report ||A_N(eta_c)-A_N(0)||_2in physical coordinates in addition to dimensionlesseta_c; compare this structured perturbation norm with r_Nwithout conflating the perturbation classes. Decide which finite chains are Hurwitz for EVERYeta in the closed interval[0,0.05]. A marginal endpoint is not strictly Hurwitz.
large_size_question: Keep all rates fixed while taking N→infinity. Derive the limit of the open spectral abscissa and the asymptotic rate lim[-log(eta_c(N))/N]. Let r_plus=(4.2+sqrt(4.2²-16))/2and determine lim[eta_c(N)*(4/r_plus)^N], with a proof from the full determinant recurrence and its dominant root, not a fit to threeNvalues. Explain why a spectral gap bounded away fromzero for the OPEN chains does not by itself provide a size-uniform positive robustness margin to boundary closure or arbitrary additive matrices. The infinite periodic winding and the large-size boundary sensitivity concern this nonreciprocal family, not a universal theorem about every topological material.

interpretation_proposals.A: A nonorthogonal similarity can preserve eigenvalues while changing Euclidean response gains and perturbation norms.
interpretation_proposals.B: The first loss of Hurwitz stability in every real matrix family must occur through eigenvector coalescence.
interpretation_proposals.C: Positive semigroup structure can certify a global zero-frequency resolvent peak without a frequency grid.
interpretation_proposals.D: A dimensionless boundary fraction and the norm of an arbitrary rate-matrix perturbation are numerically identical stability radii by definition.
interpretation_proposals.E: Periodic versus open spectra and the continuous point-gap curve can diagnose boundary sensitivity that an open spectral gap alone misses.
interpretation_proposals.F: Three finite chain lengths suffice to prove an exponential asymptotic law without an analytic recurrence.
interpretation_proposals.G: A constrained boundary perturbation cannot destabilize at a smaller physical matrix norm than the optimal arbitrary perturbation class.
interpretation_proposals.H: A Fourier curve with nonzero winding forces every finite open chain to have a positive spectral abscissa.

reporting: State order is increasing site index0..N-1. Norder is4,8,12; dictionary spectrum keys are strings4,8,12. Numeric absolute tolerance1e-7; complete root and symmetry/inverse residuals must be checked at a suitable precision. Eigenvalues and inverse-time perturbation radii retain rate units; resolvent gains have time units. The winding is an exact signed integer and phase/stability predicates are exact interpretations of the specified family. Retain actual full similarities, spectra, inverse-to-SVD handoffs, determinant recurrences, global frequency and asymptotic arguments in the trajectory. Do not replace a general nonsymmetric matrix by its symmetric part as an eigenvalue calculation.
